spans.s: च्यु vi. 1Ā (pp. च्युत; pres. च्यवते) 1. To drop down, to slip; 2. to swerve from, to fall off or away from, M.xii.71, 72; 3. to be deprived of, हॄतभार्ये च्युते राज्याद्रामे Bt.vii.92; 4. to disappear, to perish, M.xii.96; 5. to come out from, to drop from, स्वतश्च्युतं वह्निमिवाद्भिरंबुदः R.iii.58.With परि- or प्र-, 1. to go from, to proceed from; 2. to fall off, to swerve; 3. to be deprived of; 4. to drop down.
च्युत् vi. 1P (pres. च्योतति) 1. To drop, to flow, to trickle, to ooze, इदं शोणितमब्यग्रं संप्रहारेऽच्युतत् तयोः Bt.vi.28; 2. to drop down, to fall down, इदं कवचमच्योतीत् Bt.vi.29.
च्युत a. (f. ता) 1. Dropped down; 2. lost, (pp. of च्यु q.v.)
च्युत a. (f. ता) 1. Dropped down; 2. lost, (pp. of च्यु q.v.)
च्युति f. 1. Falling, a fall; 2. deviation; 3. deprivation, K.S.iii.10; 4. dropping, oozing; 5. the vulva; 6. the anus.
